# Eagle Web Creation

> Eagle Web Creation is a web design business in Wyoming's Big Horn Basin, run by Talon Grant. It builds and manages clean, fast, custom-built websites for businesses in Lovell, Cody, Powell, Greybull, Basin, Worland, Thermopolis and the surrounding area, and larger sites for statewide and multistate businesses.

- Services: website creation, website management, website consultation
- Service area: Big Horn Basin, Wyoming (Big Horn, Park, Washakie and Hot Springs counties), plus statewide and multistate clients
- Email: eaglewebcreation@gmail.com
- Phone: 307-254-8972
- Schedule a call: https://calendly.com/eaglewebcreation/30min

## Pricing

- Website creation, 1-5 pages: $800. For local small businesses that work within about a 60-mile radius.
- Website creation, 6-10 pages: $1,500. For larger businesses that advertise statewide.
- Website creation, 10+ pages: priced after a consultation. For multistate businesses and online stores.
- Website management: $75/month for 30 minutes of website work, $100/month for 1 hour, $225/month for 2 hours. Extra work is $100 per hour, billed in full hours.
- Website consultation: required for 10+ page sites and available to any business.

## How sites are built

- Custom-built, with no drag-and-drop page builders
- Mobile-first and fast loading
- SEO written around each business's services and the towns it serves
- Business details marked up with structured data for search engines and AI assistants
- Domain and DNS set up properly at launch
